environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway HTTP API (v2) with payload format version 2.0. An AWS account-level Service Control Policy (SCP) enforces that all API Gateway stages must have an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL uses a custom rule group with priority 1 that inspects ALL_QUERY_ARGS with a RegexPatternSet matching [\r\n%0d%0a%0D%0A] and action BLOCK. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a route-level throttling configuration of 50 requests per second per IP with burst of 25, enforced at the integration level. The stage also has detailed CloudWatch metrics enabled with a custom alarm that triggers an SNS→Lambda remediation function which adds the source IP to a WAF IP set (deny list) after 10 blocked requests within 60 seconds. The throttle returns 429 before the Lambda function is invoked, meaning repeated brute-force attempts to find encoding bypasses are rate-limited at the infrastructure layer before the application processes them.

auto_remediation.action: add source IP to WAF deny IP set
